description: Mean squared-distance hinge over caller-selected anchor, positive, and negative embeddings, following FaceNet §3.1 Eq. (3); callers provide unit-normalized embeddings and select triplets.

examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
    triplets = torch.randn(3, 2, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    return {"inputs": synth.Tensor(triplets), "targets": synth.Tensor(torch.zeros(3, 2))}
ds = synth.Spec("facenet-triplets", generator=samples, size=16, splits={"train": 0.75, "val": 0.25}, seed=11, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = ds.for_recipe("regression", split="train", input_field="inputs", target_field="targets", preserve_shape=True)
val = ds.for_recipe("regression", split="val", like=train, input_field="inputs", target_field="targets", preserve_shape=True)
class NormalizedEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.encoder = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=2, out_features=2)
    def forward(self, inputs):
        batch_size = inputs.shape[0]
        encoded = self.encoder(inputs.reshape(-1, inputs.shape[-1]))
        encoded = encoded.reshape(batch_size, 3, -1)
        return torch.nn.functional.normalize(encoded, dim=-1)
model = NormalizedEncoder()
trainer = Trainer(model, train, val, recipe="regression", recipe_config={"loss": "facenet", "loss_kwargs": {"margin": 0.2}}, batch_size=4, max_epochs=1, device="cpu", logger="none", monitor="none")
trainer.fit()
assert all(torch.isfinite(torch.tensor(value)) for value in trainer.evaluate(val).values())
examples.title: Train a normalized triplet encoder with FaceNet loss

name: FaceNet squared Euclidean triplet loss

parameters.ignore_index: must be None; FaceNet triplet loss defines no ignored-target behavior
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point tensor [T, 3, D] ordered anchor, positive, negative; callers L2-normalize each embedding
parameters.margin: nonnegative finite hinge margin (default 0.2, the experimental value reported in FaceNet §3.3)
parameters.reduction: none per triplet, mean, or sum (default mean)
parameters.targets: accepted and ignored because triplet membership is encoded in logits_or_prediction
